summary: RptMnuAssignmentChanges is a report-generating user control in an ASP.NET application, designed to display and export assignment change information for students. It uses a stored procedure (ReportAssignmentChanges) and allows users to select a cutover date to filter report data. The control validates input, manages state, and provides UI features for date selection and export.
purpose: To allow users to generate, view, and export reports on student assignment changes by specifying a cutover date and interacting with assignment change data. Supports Excel export and provides information in HTML format, with business rules and validation for input.

workflows.name: Generate Assignment Change Report
steps: User enters or selects a cutover date in txtStartDate.
Input is validated (required and regex validation).
User clicks cmdRunExcel to trigger report.
SessionID and CutoverDate parameters are added.
Stored procedure is executed to fetch report data.
Report output is formatted as HTML/CSV.
HTML report is displayed in lblReportHTML and pnlReportHTML.
User can export the report to Excel.

business_rules: Cutover date is mandatory and validated via required and regex validators.
Report data is filtered based on cutover date provided.
SessionID must be attached to the procedure call for user context.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator ensures txtStartDate is not empty.
RegularExpressionValidator ensures correct date format in txtStartDate.
calculations: DateFormatter.ParseDate converts txtStartDate input to proper date format for database.
conditions: Report is only generated if txtStartDate is valid.
Report HTML is displayed only if reportHTML is not empty.
system_behavior: On Page_PreRender, report description and options are set based on code lookup.
SetupJavaScript is invoked to initialize client-side variables and interactions.
On Excel button click, stored procedure is executed and report data output.
dependencies: ASP.NET server controls (TextBox, Button, Panel, etc.)
exceptions: If txtStartDate is invalid or missing, report generation is blocked.
If stored procedure returns no data, reportHTML may be empty and report will not display.
